title: (RHBA-2017:1094) Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Jenkins Image Release Advisory
portal_summary: Updated Jenkins images that fix one bug and add various enhancements are now available for Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Jenkins Image Release Advisory
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.5|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, ensure all previously released errata relevant to your system have been applied.

For instructions on new installations, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/install_config/install/planning.html

For instructions on how to properly upgrade existing clusters to OpenShift
Container Platform 3.5, see the following documentation:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/install_config/upgrading/index.html
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform is the company's cloud computing Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) solution designed for on-premise or private cloud deployments.

Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform provides a container image for running
Jenkins. This image provides a Jenkins server instance, which can be used
to set up a basic flow for continuous testing, integration, and delivery.

This advisory contains the container images for this release. See the following advisory for the RPM packages for this release:

https://access.redhat.com/errata/RHBA-2017:0991

This update fixes the following bug:

* The Jenkins images for OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 (jenkins-1-rhel7, jenkins-2-rhel7, jenkins-slave-maven-rhel7, and jenkins-slave-nodejs-rhel7) were missing from registry.access.redhat.com. This bug fix adds the missing images. (BZ#1442834)

This update includes the following images:

openshift3/jenkins-1-rhel7:1.651.2-54
openshift3/jenkins-2-rhel7:2.32-4
openshift3/jenkins-slave-base-rhel7:1.0-14
openshift3/jenkins-slave-maven-rhel7:3.3-15
openshift3/jenkins-slave-nodejs-rhel7:4-14

The OpenShift Container Platform 3.5 Release Notes provide information
about new features, bug fixes, and known issues:

https://docs.openshift.com/container-platform/3.5/release_notes/ocp_3_5_rel
ease_notes.html
